tokens.name: logo-red
tokens.usage: The exact red of the ACENZ logo. Only for the logo itself and large brand blocks (cover, hero); never for text or controls — use brand.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — bright warm white in light, warm near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, inputs, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar, table header rows, empty upload dropzones.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and dropzones (≥3:1 on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — meta lines, timestamps, helper text — on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: ACENZ red for actions: primary buttons, links, active nav, selected tabs, progress fills. A shade deeper than the logo red so white text passes 4.5:1. Readable as text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active nav background, current-class highlight.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text on brand-soft.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Pastel peach — band score chips and achievement highlights. Fill only, with on-accent text; never text on its own.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (band score chip).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of score summaries and highlighted essay passages.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft, surface or surface-raised when it must read as peach.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Graded / submitted on time / present. Always with an icon or word — it differs from danger by hue only.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due soon / needs revision. Text on warning-soft and surface-raised.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Late, missing, overdue, destructive actions. Close to brand red, so it ALWAYS comes with an icon and a word, on danger-soft or as an outlined button — never as a solid fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges and banners.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Announcements and neutral notices. Text on info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info banners and announcement notifications.

tokens.name: skill-listening
tokens.usage: IELTS Listening — tag text, icon and chart series.

tokens.name: skill-listening-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Listening tags.

tokens.name: skill-reading
tokens.usage: IELTS Reading — tag text, icon and chart series.

tokens.name: skill-reading-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Reading tags.

tokens.name: skill-writing
tokens.usage: IELTS Writing — tag text, icon and chart series.

tokens.name: skill-writing-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Writing tags.

tokens.name: skill-speaking
tokens.usage: IELTS Speaking — tag text, icon and chart series.

tokens.name: skill-speaking-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Speaking tags.

tokens.name: nav-surface
tokens.usage: Sidebar background — white in light (separated by nav-line), warm dark in dark.

tokens.name: nav-ink
tokens.usage: Sidebar text and icons on nav-surface and nav-hover.

tokens.name: nav-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive nav items and sidebar meta text on nav-surface.

tokens.name: nav-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered nav item background.

tokens.name: nav-line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: Active nav item background — pastel red tint; text on it is nav-active-ink.

tokens.name: nav-active-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon of the active nav item, on nav-active.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px, 2px offset. ≥3:1 on every surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Dashboard greeting, empty-state hero. Once per screen.
styles.sample: Chào Linh, sẵn sàng cho Band 7.0?

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Reading passages, essay text and teacher feedback.
styles.sample: Some people believe that university education should be free for everyone.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Meta lines, table cells, helper text.
styles.sample: Cập nhật 2 giờ trước · 18/24 học viên đã nộp

styles.name: score-lg
styles.usage: Overall band score on results and profile.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Band score chips per skill or per assignment.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact rows; badge horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between form label and input; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (default).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top padding of page headers.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, checkboxes, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows, notification items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, dropzones.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, score chips, pills, progress bars.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, dropdowns, notification panel.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and toasts.

breakpoint.note: Layout breakpoints. Components switch on the width of their own container (container queries); use the same values for page-level media queries.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Small phones and up. Below this, single column, full-width buttons in forms.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet portrait. Below this: phone layout — sidebar hidden, Topbar menu button, BottomNav, RosterTable as cards, 1 card per row.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Laptop. Below this: sidebar collapses to a 72px icon rail, 2 cards per row.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Desktop. Content max width 1200px; 3–4 cards per row.
